description: Watch a YouTube channel or TikTok/Instagram profile for new videos (Starter/Pro plan required). Monitor checks cost 0 credits; only newly transcribed videos when transcripts=true bill credits.

chunks.description: Split transcript into o200k_base token chunks (true for defaults, or { max_tokens, overlap_tokens }).

interval_minutes.description: Polling interval in minutes (15, 60, 360, or 1440; defaults to 60).

markdown.description: Include Markdown rendering on transcribed monitor events.

mode.description: Transcript engine when transcripts=true; defaults to captions (built-in captions only, never speech-to-text). audio transcribes every new upload with speech-to-text and auto falls back to it when captions are missing, both billed per audio minute: use them only when the user asks for speech-to-text.

platform.description: Optional platform hint for bare handles.

seed_latest.description: Seed last_seen_video_id with the latest existing video so historical uploads do not trigger events; defaults to true.

tab.description: YouTube channel tab; defaults to videos.

transcripts.description: Automatically transcribe newly detected videos (billed per delivered video); defaults to false.

url.description: Channel/profile URL, @handle, or UC... channel ID.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL signed with X-TranscriptLab-Signature.

name: transcriptlab_create_monitor
title: Create channel monitor
